service.description: A new pipeline of an organization (organizationPartyId in the caller's scope, a name, an optional current team of that organization, TEAM_UNAVAILABLE; from fromDate, now or later), or an existing pipeline's name, description, team, default flag or end (end, or thruDate now or later), naming the revision read (expectedRevision, REVISION_CHANGED). One default per organization: setting it clears the organization's other. The shared pipeline (no organization) is changed only by a caller of every organization's scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED); another organization's answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. A pipeline whose stages hold open deals is not ended (PIPELINE_IN_USE). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED). Nothing is deleted.

A new stage of a pipeline (a name unique among its current stages, DUPLICATE_VALUE; a default probability from 0 to 100, PROBABILITY_INVALID; an order from 0 to 9999, SEQUENCE_INVALID, last when empty; whether the board folds it), or an existing stage's name, probability, order or fold flag, a move up or down among the pipeline's current stages (move), or its retirement (retire): a stage holding open deals (not Won or Lost) is retired only with reassignStageId, another current stage of the same pipeline (STAGE_IN_USE without it, STAGE_INVALID for another), to which each open deal moves, audit-logged; closed deals keep the retired stage. A change of an existing stage names the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED); a retired one is not changed (RECORD_ENDED). The pipeline's organization in the caller's scope (the shared pipeline: every organization's). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE. Never deleted.

parameter.name: moved
parameter.description: The open deals moved to reassignStageId

service.description: A new sales team of an organization in the caller's scope (an Organization party with the SalesTeam role, owned by the organization, its PrtSalesTeamOf row from fromDate, now or later; a name unique among its current teams, DUPLICATE_VALUE; managerPartyId, a person who works for the organization, MEMBER_INVALID, joins as its Manager), or a team's name or end (end, or thruDate now or later; its memberships end with it), naming the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED). Another organization's team answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE or SALES_TEAM_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED). Nothing is deleted; a team grants no permission.

A person joins a team (partyId: a person who works for the team's organization, an agent or employee in effect, MEMBER_INVALID; roleTypeId SalesRepresentative, the default, or Manager) from fromDate, now or later (DATE_INVALID), until thruDate when given; a person has one membership of a team at a time (MEMBER_EXISTS). Or a membership ends (partyRelationshipId, its revision, thruDate now or later; one not started ends at its start). Changes access prospectively and rewrites no attribution. The team in the caller's scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE or SALES_TEAM_MANAGE. Never deleted.

A new lead source (a moqui.basic.DataSource of a LEAD_SOURCE type, TYPE_INVALID; a name no lead source has, DUPLICATE_VALUE) offered to organizationPartyId from now; an existing source's name or type, by a caller whose scope covers every organization it is offered to (SOURCE_SHARED), naming its revision; or its offer to an organization of the caller's added (bind, from fromDate now or later; BINDING_EXISTS) or ended (unbind, thruDate now or later). A source is shared by the instance and never deleted; ending an offer leaves the records that name it. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE and the organization in the caller's scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

A new lost reason (a SalesLostReason value: a name no current reason has, DUPLICATE_VALUE; an order from 0 to 9999, last when empty), or a reason's name, order or end (end, or thruDate now or later), naming its revision. An ended reason stays on the records that hold it and is offered for no new one; never deleted. The reasons are the instance's. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE.

What an organization offers now, to any Sales reader of it (SALES_VIEW, SALES_TEAM_VIEW or SALES_REPORT_VIEW, PERMISSION_DENIED; the organization in their scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED): the opportunity types (Lead, Opportunity), the outcomes, its pipelines in effect (its own and the shared one) with their current stages and its default, its current teams, the lead sources offered to it, the current lost reasons and the recurring plans (enumCode: months).

parameter.name: pipelines
parameter.description: salesPipelineId, pipelineName, organizationPartyId, shared, teamPartyId, teamName, isDefault, stages [{opportunityStageId, description, defaultProbability, sequenceNum, folded}]

service.description: An organization's settings as its configurer or team manager reads them (SALES_CONFIGURE or SALES_TEAM_MANAGE; the organization in their scope): its teams with their dated members (manager names, current count, each membership's state and revision); and for SALES_CONFIGURE the pipelines it is offered with their stages and each stage's open deals, the lead sources (offered there or not; the other organizations named when in the caller's scope, else "other organizations"), the lost reasons and the types; ended rows with includeEnded; and whether the caller may change each part (canConfigure, canManageTeams, canEditShared, a pipeline's canEdit, a source's canRename).
